$comment: Nudge targets .NET 10. This machine also has a .NET 8 SDK at C:\Program Files\dotnet, which
comes first on the system PATH. Pinning the SDK here means that if the wrong dotnet.exe is used,
the build fails with a clear message instead of quietly compiling against .NET 8.
Use D:\dotnet\dotnet.exe, or put D:\dotnet ahead of C:\Program Files\dotnet on PATH.
